name: gov.br portal pages (CTIR Gov alerts, Anatel open-data page)
operator: Governo Federal do Brasil (gov.br portal, Secretaria de Governo Digital)
tier_rationale: Federal government portal (Secretaria de Governo Digital) publishing pages of government bodies (A8 'government bodies': trusted). P298's unknown tier is the lowest of its anonymous feeds, recorded per feed (P298 cond 9), not a statement about gov.br; P126 is offline (tier n/a).

reliability.justification: Official publications of federal government bodies (CTIR Gov alerts and recommendations, Anatel open-data index).

ctir_alerts.title: CTIR Gov alerts and recommendations page www.gov.br/ctir

terms.quote: Licence (A1, legal floor): feed terms are 'unknown' until legal reviews them, so nothing runs yet in any profile.

ctir_alerts.notes: Quote: binding council text (P298 cond 3). Research C0754: the CTIR Gov alerts page was in maintenance during research (it answered 200 on 2026-11-26) and joins only after re-verification from the team network (P298 cond 2). Headline + link + date only, polled at most hourly with conditional GET; safe XML helper, 2 MB cap, <= 200 items (P298 cond 4-5). Disabled in every profile until legal records its class (A1). Used by cti_news_rss.

anatel_open_data.title: Anatel open-data page www.gov.br/anatel (numbering datasets; deferred)
anatel_open_data.notes: Quote: research C0800 terms (status unverified: CONNECT 502 from the research egress; the page answered 200 on 2026-11-26). Deferred (P126 cond 6): this page is only the dataset index; the numbering datasets themselves are on dadosabertos.anatel.gov.br (another provider) and become a registered dataset once their URL is verified from the team network. Used by phone_parse (maintainer data script; the module itself is offline).

notes: Shared seed for batches p1-G06-1, p2-G11-1 (P126, P298): batches only extend it (govbr__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Only www.gov.br: other gov.br hosts belong to their own providers, and later sources on www.gov.br (for example the MTE 'lista suja' CSV of P244 cond 1) are added by govbr__<batch>.json extensions. Geo-restricted gov.br endpoints follow A9 (requires_egress BR at module level). ttl 1 h: feeds are polled at most hourly (P298 cond 4). .br host: Accept-Language pt-BR by default.
